Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <fab7d6cf.03050...@posting.google.com>, WIN

<w...@gamesweb.sk> writes:
>That is stupid. Sorry, but is there anywhere written "Camarilla
>Location"? This is such a nonsense, because if Camarilla Gangrels are
>able to play those locations, how can it become independent?

The same way that any other non-default sect card is played.

For instance, a Giovanni with a Writ of Acceptance (Camarilla, default
of clan is Independent) is still capable of being the Giovanni you use
to allow you to play The Mausoleum.

Lucita (Independent, default of clan is Sabbat) is still capable of
being the Lasombra you use to allow you to play Power Structure, and is
still capable of equipping herself with San Nicolás de los Servitas.

Anka, Priestess of Thorns (Sabbat, default of clan is Independent), is
still capable of allowing you to play a Park Hunting Ground, acquiring a
Treasured Samadji or playing (or benefiting from) Patshiv.

Angela Preston (Camarilla, default of clan is Independent); Delilah
Monroe (Sabbat, default of clan is Independent); or Gael Pilet
(Independent, default of clan is Independent) are all capable of playing
Concert Tour or benefiting from the Paris Opera House or letting you
play it.

And so on.

The Gangrel from Groups 1 and 2 are (will be) simply different to the
default status of the clan. Everything functions just as it would for
the above.

Just because you have Angela Preston, Celeste and Muse in play doesn't
allow Al-Ashrad to burn down the Paris Opera House.

And just as similarly, if Angela creates a little baby vampire, that
vampire is Independent.
